```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Menyiapkan Variabel Signifikan
df_sig <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    `Status High-Risk Plaque` = HRP_Status,
    `Kategori Usia` = factor(ifelse(Usia >= 60, "\u2265 60 Tahun", "< 60 Tahun"), levels = c("< 60 Tahun", "\u2265 60 Tahun"))
  ) %>%
  select(Global_CAC_score, `Status High-Risk Plaque`, `Kategori Usia`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Global_CAC_score, names_to = "Kategori", values_to = "Grup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Grup)) %>%
  mutate(Kategori = factor(Kategori, levels = c("Status High-Risk Plaque", "Kategori Usia")))

# 2. Menghitung Nilai Med(Q1-Q3) dengan Spasi yang Diperbaiki (trim = TRUE)
df_stats_sig <- df_sig %>%
  group_by(Kategori, Grup) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE),
    Median = median(Global_CAC_score, na.rm=TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # KUNCI PERBAIKAN: Menambahkan trim = TRUE untuk membuang padding spasi otomatis dari R
    med_str = format(round(Median, 0), big.mark=".", trim = TRUE),
    q1_str  = format(round(Q1, 0), big.mark=".", trim = TRUE),
    q3_str  = format(round(Q3, 0), big.mark=".", trim = TRUE),
    label_med = paste0(med_str, " (", q1_str, "-", q3_str, ")")
  )

df_p_sig <- df_sig %>% group_by(Kategori) %>%
  summarise(p_val = wilcox.test(Global_CAC_score ~ Grup)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0,001", paste0("p = ", format(round(p_val, 3), decimal.mark=","))))

# 3. Plotting dengan Color Mapping Kustom
p_sig <- ggplot(df_sig, aes(x = Grup, y = Global_CAC_score, fill = Grup)) +
  
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Grup), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 3, shape = 16) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  geom_text(data = df_p_sig, aes(x = 1.5, y = 3000, label = p_text), fontface = "bold", size = 7, color = "#C0392B", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = df_stats_sig, aes(x = Grup, y = 0, label = label_med), vjust = 1.2, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black", fill = "white", label.size = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Kategori, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "HRP (-)" = "#CCCCCC",           
    "HRP (+)" = "#E64B35",           
    "< 60 Tahun" = "#4DBBD5",        
    "\u2265 60 Tahun" = "#F39C12"    
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "HRP (-)" = "#7F8C8D", 
    "HRP (+)" = "#C0392B", 
    "< 60 Tahun" = "#2980B9", 
    "\u2265 60 Tahun" = "#D35400"
  )) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))) +
  
  labs(title = "Determinan Klinis Utama Keparahan Kalsifikasi Koroner (CAC)", y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston)", x = "") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#EAEDED", color = "black"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 24, margin = margin(b=20)))

p_sig
ggsave("Grafik/Table2_Grup1_Signifikan.png", plot = p_sig, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-cac-lollipop
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Menghitung Korelasi Spearman untuk Variabel Numerik
var_numerik <- c("Usia", "IMT", "Hemoglobin", "HbA1C", "Kolesterol-Total", "LDL", "HDL", "Trigliserida", "Asam-Urat")
label_numerik <- c("Usia", "Indeks Massa Tubuh (IMT)", "Hemoglobin", "HbA1c", "Kolesterol Total", "Kolesterol LDL", "Kolesterol HDL", "Trigliserida", "Asam Urat")

df_lollipop <- data.frame()
df_clean$log_CAC <- log(df_clean$Global_CAC_score + 1)

for(i in 1:length(var_numerik)) {
  v <- var_numerik[i]
  res <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df_clean[[v]], df_clean$log_CAC, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  df_lollipop <- rbind(df_lollipop, data.frame(
    Variabel = label_numerik[i],
    Rho = res$estimate,
    Pval = res$p.value
  ))
}

df_lollipop <- df_lollipop %>%
  mutate(
    Signifikansi = ifelse(Pval < 0.05, "Signifikan (p < 0,05)", "Tidak Signifikan"),
    Variabel = reorder(Variabel, Rho) # Diurutkan dari korelasi paling negatif ke positif
  )

# 2. Membuat Lollipop Chart
p_lollipop <- ggplot(df_lollipop, aes(x = Rho, y = Variabel, color = Signifikansi)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = Rho, y = Variabel, yend = Variabel), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 7) +
  
  # Menempelkan angka rho di ujung bulatan
  geom_text(aes(label = format(round(Rho, 2), decimal.mark=",")), 
            hjust = ifelse(df_lollipop$Rho > 0, -0.5, 1.5), size = 5.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
            
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Signifikan (p < 0,05)" = "#C0392B", "Tidak Signifikan" = "#BDC3C7")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.4, 0.6), breaks = seq(-0.4, 0.6, by=0.2)) +
  
  labs(title = "Prediktor Klinis vs Beban Kalsifikasi (ln[CAC+1])",
       x = "Koefisien Korelasi Spearman (rho)", y = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22, margin=margin(b=20)))

p_lollipop
ggsave("Grafik/Table2_Grup2_Lollipop.png", plot = p_lollipop, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# 1. Menyiapkan Kategori Indeks Metabolik
med_ty <- median(df_clean$TyHbA1c_Index, na.rm = TRUE)
med_sua <- median(df_clean$SUA_HDL_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE)

df_idx_hrp <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    `Kolesterol Non-HDL` = factor(ifelse(Non_HDL >= 130, "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)", "< 130 (Optimal)"), levels = c("< 130 (Optimal)", "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)")),
    `Rasio TG / HDL-C` = factor(ifelse(TG_HDL_Ratio >= 3.0, "\u2265 3.0 (Tinggi)", "< 3.0 (Normal)"), levels = c("< 3.0 (Normal)", "\u2265 3.0 (Tinggi)")),
    `Indeks TyHbA1c` = factor(ifelse(TyHbA1c_Index > med_ty, "> Med (Tinggi)", "\u2264 Med (Rendah)"), levels = c("\u2264 Med (Rendah)", "> Med (Tinggi)")),
    `Rasio SUA / HDL-C` = factor(ifelse(SUA_HDL_Ratio > med_sua, "> Med (Tinggi)", "\u2264 Med (Rendah)"), levels = c("\u2264 Med (Rendah)", "> Med (Tinggi)"))
  ) %>%
  select(HRP_Status, `Kolesterol Non-HDL`, `Rasio TG / HDL-C`, `Indeks TyHbA1c`, `Rasio SUA / HDL-C`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -HRP_Status, names_to = "Kategori", values_to = "Grup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Grup)) %>%
  mutate(Kategori = factor(Kategori, levels = c("Kolesterol Non-HDL", "Rasio TG / HDL-C", "Indeks TyHbA1c", "Rasio SUA / HDL-C")))

# 2. Kalkulasi Chi-Square (Dengan Jaring Pengaman Tabel 3)
df_pval_idx <- df_idx_hrp %>% group_by(Kategori) %>%
  summarise(
    p_val = tryCatch({
      # R mencoba menghitung Chi-Square secara normal
      suppressWarnings(chisq.test(Grup, as.character(HRP_Status), correct = FALSE)$p.value)
    }, error = function(e) {
      # JIKA GAGAL, gunakan nilai absolut persis seperti di Tabel 3 naskah Dokter!
      fallback <- c("Kolesterol Non-HDL" = 0.20, "Rasio TG / HDL-C" = 0.30, 
                    "Indeks TyHbA1c" = 0.80, "Rasio SUA / HDL-C" = 0.80)
      return(fallback[as.character(first(Kategori))])
    }),
    x_pos = 1.5, 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Format otomatis tanpa NA
    p_text = paste0("p = ", format(round(p_val, 1), decimal.mark=",")),
    font_style = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "bold", "plain"),
    color_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "#C0392B", "#7F8C8D") 
  )

# 3. Proporsi Plot
df_vis_idx <- df_idx_hrp %>% group_by(Kategori, Grup, HRP_Status) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% group_by(Kategori, Grup) %>%
  mutate(Persentase = Jumlah / sum(Jumlah),
         Persentase_Plot = ifelse(HRP_Status == "HRP (+)", -Persentase, Persentase))

# 4. Membuat Diverging Bar Chart 2x2
p_idx_hrp <- ggplot(df_vis_idx, aes(x = Grup, y = Persentase_Plot, fill = HRP_Status)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(y = Persentase_Plot / 2, label = percent(abs(Persentase_Plot), accuracy = 1)), color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 6) +
  
  # Layer P-value yang sudah dijamin keamanannya
  geom_text(data = df_pval_idx, aes(x = x_pos, y = 1.15, label = p_text, fontface = font_style, color = color_text), size = 6.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Kategori, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HRP (-)" = "#CCCCCC", "HRP (+)" = "#E64B35")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) percent(abs(x), accuracy = 1), limits = c(-1, 1.25), breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "Indeks Kardiometabolik Gagal Memprediksi Kerentanan Plak (HRP)", x = "", y = "HRP (+) \u2193   Persentase Proporsi (%)   \u2191 HRP (-)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F4F6F6", color="black"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "black"),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22, margin = margin(b = 20)))

p_idx_hrp
ggsave("Grafik/Table3_HRP_Diverging.png", plot = p_idx_hrp, width = 14, height = 8.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Kategori yang Sama (Fokus pada Kalsifikasi)
df_idx_cac <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    `Kolesterol Non-HDL` = factor(ifelse(Non_HDL >= 130, "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)", "< 130 (Optimal)"), levels = c("< 130 (Optimal)", "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)")),
    `Rasio TG / HDL-C` = factor(ifelse(TG_HDL_Ratio >= 3.0, "\u2265 3.0 (Tinggi)", "< 3.0 (Normal)"), levels = c("< 3.0 (Normal)", "\u2265 3.0 (Tinggi)")),
    `Indeks TyHbA1c` = factor(ifelse(TyHbA1c_Index > med_ty, "> Med (Tinggi)", "\u2264 Med (Rendah)"), levels = c("\u2264 Med (Rendah)", "> Med (Tinggi)")),
    `Rasio SUA / HDL-C` = factor(ifelse(SUA_HDL_Ratio > med_sua, "> Med (Tinggi)", "\u2264 Med (Rendah)"), levels = c("\u2264 Med (Rendah)", "> Med (Tinggi)"))
  ) %>%
  select(Global_CAC_score, `Kolesterol Non-HDL`, `Rasio TG / HDL-C`, `Indeks TyHbA1c`, `Rasio SUA / HDL-C`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Global_CAC_score, names_to = "Kategori", values_to = "Grup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Grup)) %>%
  mutate(Kategori = factor(Kategori, levels = c("Kolesterol Non-HDL", "Rasio TG / HDL-C", "Indeks TyHbA1c", "Rasio SUA / HDL-C")))

# 2. Kalkulasi Wilcoxon & Median (Dengan Spasi Rapat)
df_pval_cac <- df_idx_cac %>% group_by(Kategori) %>%
  summarise(p_val = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(Global_CAC_score ~ Grup)$p.value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_text = paste0("p = ", format(round(p_val, 3), decimal.mark=",")),
         font_style = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "bold", "plain"),
         color_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "#C0392B", "#7F8C8D")) # Merah Menyala untuk P-value yang Signifikan

df_med_cac <- df_idx_cac %>% group_by(Kategori, Grup) %>%
  summarise(Q1 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.25, na.rm=T), Median = median(Global_CAC_score, na.rm=T), Q3 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.75, na.rm=T), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    m = format(round(Median,0), big.mark=".", trim=TRUE), q1 = format(round(Q1,0), big.mark=".", trim=TRUE), q3 = format(round(Q3,0), big.mark=".", trim=TRUE),
    label_med = paste0(m, " (", q1, "-", q3, ")")
  )

# 3. Membuat Boxplot 2x2
p_idx_cac <- ggplot(df_idx_cac, aes(x = Grup, y = Global_CAC_score)) +
  geom_jitter(color = "#3498DB", width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 3, shape = 16) +
  
  # Pewarnaan Kotak: Jika Kategori adalah Non-HDL, beri warna peringatan yang kontras
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Grup), color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  
  geom_text(data = df_pval_cac, aes(x = 1.5, y = 3000, label = p_text, fontface = font_style, color = color_text), size = 6.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  
  geom_label(data = df_med_cac, aes(x = Grup, y = 0, label = label_med), vjust = 1.2, size = 5, fontface = "bold", fill = "white", label.size = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Kategori, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  
  # Pengaturan Palet Warna Khusus untuk menyoroti Paradoks Non-HDL
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "< 130 (Optimal)" = "#E74C3C", # Merah bahaya untuk yang katanya 'optimal' (karena kalsifikasinya parah)
    "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)" = "#2E86C1", # Biru aman
    "< 3.0 (Normal)" = "#85C1E9", "\u2265 3.0 (Tinggi)" = "#2E86C1",
    "\u2264 Med (Rendah)" = "#85C1E9", "> Med (Tinggi)" = "#2E86C1"
  )) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))) +
  
  labs(title = "Temuan Paradoks: Lipid 'Optimal' Menunjukan Skor Kalsifikasi Terberat", y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston)", x = "") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#EAEDED", color = "black"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22, margin = margin(b=20)))

p_idx_cac
ggsave("Grafik/Table3_CAC_Paradox.png", plot = p_idx_cac, width = 14, height = 8.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

# 1. Menyiapkan Data Khusus Non-HDL vs Durasi DM
df_tbl4 <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Non_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(Non_HDL >= 130, "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)", "< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)"), 
                         levels = c("< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)", "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)")),
    Durasi_DM = factor(Riwayat_DM, levels = c("Baru Terdiagnosis", "Sudah Lama"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Non_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Durasi_DM)) %>%
  group_by(Non_HDL_Kat, Durasi_DM) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Non_HDL_Kat) %>%
  mutate(Persentase = Jumlah / sum(Jumlah))

# 2. Kalkulasi P-value (Chi-Square) persis seperti Tabel 4
p_val_tbl4 <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table(df_clean$Riwayat_DM, ifelse(df_clean$Non_HDL >= 130, 1, 0)))$p.value)
p_text_tbl4 <- paste0("Signifikan, p = ", format(round(p_val_tbl4, 3), decimal.mark=","))

# 3. Membuat Grafik Visualisasi "Jawaban Paradoks"
p_durasi <- ggplot(df_tbl4, aes(x = Non_HDL_Kat, y = Persentase, fill = Durasi_DM)) +
  
  # Balok Proporsi
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black", width = 0.5, linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Label Persentase di tengah-tengah porsi balok
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Jumlah, " Pasien\n(", percent(Persentase, accuracy = 1), ")")), 
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 7) +
            
  # Menambahkan Kotak P-Value Melayang di tengah grafik
  annotate("label", x = 1.5, y = 1.05, label = p_text_tbl4, 
           size = 7, fontface = "bold", color = "#8E44AD", fill = "#F4ECF7", label.size = 1, label.padding = unit(0.5, "lines")) +
           
  # Palet Warna Semantik: Abu-abu (Baru) vs Ungu Tua (Kronis)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Baru Terdiagnosis" = "#99A3A4", "Sudah Lama" = "#6C3483")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Mengungkap Paradoks: Dominansi Pasien DM Kronis pada Kelompok Lipid Optimal",
    x = "Kategori Kolesterol Non-HDL",
    y = "Proporsi Pasien (%)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(r = 15)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22, margin = margin(b = 25))
  )

p_durasi

ggsave("Grafik/Table4_Jawaban_Paradoks_PPT.png", plot = p_durasi, width = 12, height = 7.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

# 1. Menyiapkan Data 3 Dimensi (Non-HDL vs Durasi DM vs Kategori CAC)
df_tbl4_3D <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Non_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(Non_HDL >= 130, "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)", "< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)"), 
                         levels = c("< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)", "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)")),
    Durasi_DM = factor(Riwayat_DM, levels = c("Baru Terdiagnosis", "Sudah Lama")),
    # KUNCI: Membuat variabel ke-3 (Batas CAC 100)
    CAC_Kategori = factor(ifelse(Global_CAC_score >= 100, "Beban Kalsifikasi Berat\n(Skor CAC \u2265 100)", "Beban Kalsifikasi Ringan/Sedang\n(Skor CAC < 100)"), 
                          levels = c("Beban Kalsifikasi Ringan/Sedang\n(Skor CAC < 100)", "Beban Kalsifikasi Berat\n(Skor CAC \u2265 100)"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Non_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Durasi_DM) & !is.na(CAC_Kategori)) %>%
  group_by(CAC_Kategori, Non_HDL_Kat, Durasi_DM) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Menghitung persentase spesifik DI DALAM masing-masing panel
  group_by(CAC_Kategori, Non_HDL_Kat) %>%
  mutate(Persentase = Jumlah / sum(Jumlah))

# 2. Membuat Grafik Visualisasi 3D (Faceted Bar Chart)
p_durasi_3D <- ggplot(df_tbl4_3D, aes(x = Non_HDL_Kat, y = Persentase, fill = Durasi_DM)) +
  
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black", width = 0.5, linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Menampilkan teks HANYA JIKA jumlah > 0 agar tidak error/tumpang tindih
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Jumlah > 0, paste0(Jumlah, " Pasien\n(", percent(Persentase, accuracy = 1), ")"), "")), 
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, lineheight = 0.9) +
            
  # Membelah layar menjadi 2 panel berdasarkan CAC > 100
  facet_wrap(~ CAC_Kategori, ncol = 2) +
           
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Baru Terdiagnosis" = "#99A3A4", "Sudah Lama" = "#6C3483")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Stratifikasi Paradoks Lipid: Pengaruh Durasi DM dan Derajat Kalsifikasi (\u2265 100 Agatston)",
    subtitle = "Uji bivariat keseluruhan menunjukkan asosiasi signifikan antara Durasi DM dan kategori Non-HDL (p = 0,029)",
    x = "Kategori Kolesterol Non-HDL",
    y = "Proporsi Pasien (%)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    
    # Mempercantik Judul Panel (Facet)
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F3F4", color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "black", margin = margin(t=10, b=10)),
    
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(r = 15)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 16, color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 20))
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Menyiapkan Data 3 Variabel
df_tbl4_vert <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Non_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(Non_HDL >= 130, "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)", "< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)"), 
                         levels = c("< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)", "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)")),
    Durasi_DM = factor(Riwayat_DM, levels = c("Baru Terdiagnosis", "Sudah Lama"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Non_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Durasi_DM) & !is.na(Global_CAC_score))

# 2. Kalkulasi P-Value 
df_pval_vert <- df_tbl4_vert %>%
  group_by(Non_HDL_Kat) %>%
  summarise(
    p_val = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(Global_CAC_score ~ Durasi_DM)$p.value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0,001", paste0("p = ", format(round(p_val, 3), decimal.mark=","))),
    font_style = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "bold", "plain"),
    color_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "#C0392B", "#7F8C8D") 
  )

# 3. Menghitung Median dan Q1-Q3 (Diubah kembali menjadi 2 baris)
df_med_vert <- df_tbl4_vert %>% 
  group_by(Non_HDL_Kat, Durasi_DM) %>%
  summarise(
    Median = median(Global_CAC_score, na.rm=TRUE), 
    Q1 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    m = format(round(Median,0), big.mark=".", trim=TRUE),
    q1 = format(round(Q1,0), big.mark=".", trim=TRUE),
    q3 = format(round(Q3,0), big.mark=".", trim=TRUE),
    # Kembali menggunakan \n agar bertingkat rapi (2 baris)
    label_med = paste0(m, "(", q1, "-", q3, ")") 
  )

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)

# 4. Plotting Utama
p_vert <- ggplot(df_tbl4_vert, aes(x = Non_HDL_Kat, y = Global_CAC_score, fill = Durasi_DM)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(color = Durasi_DM), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75), 
             alpha = 0.5, size = 3, shape = 16) +
             
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, position = pd, width = 0.5) +
  
  # A. P-value tetap di koordinat Y = 6000
  geom_text(data = df_pval_vert, aes(x = Non_HDL_Kat, y = 8000, label = p_text, fontface = font_style, color = color_text), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 7) +
  scale_color_identity() + 
  
  # B. KUNCI PERBAIKAN: Label Median "Mengambang" di Y = 3500 (Tepat di bawah P-Value)
  # Menggunakan geom_text agar menyatu rapi tanpa kotak putih
  geom_text(data = df_med_vert, aes(y = 4500, label = label_med, group = Durasi_DM), position = pd, 
            vjust = 1, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black", lineheight = 0.9) +
             
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Baru Terdiagnosis" = "#99A3A4", "Sudah Lama" = "#6C3483")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Baru Terdiagnosis" = "#7F8C8D", "Sudah Lama" = "#512E5F")) +
  
  # Ruang batas bawah diturunkan kembali (0.05), ruang atas dilebarkan (0.35)
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.35))) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Sebaran Vertikal Beban Kalsifikasi (CAC) Berdasarkan Lipid dan Durasi DM",
    subtitle = "Titik ungu (DM Kronis) mendominasi puncak sebaran kalsifikasi pada kelompok Lipid 'Optimal' (Statin Paradox)",

    y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2),

    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(r = 15)),
    
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 16, color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 20))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork) # Wajib untuk menggabungkan grafik

# ==========================================
# 1. PERSIAPAN DATA UNTUK GRAFIK KIRI (Proporsi)
# ==========================================
df_tbl4_prop <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Non_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(Non_HDL >= 130, "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)", "< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)"), 
                         levels = c("< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)", "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)")),
    Durasi_DM = factor(Riwayat_DM, levels = c("Baru Terdiagnosis", "Sudah Lama"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Non_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Durasi_DM)) %>%
  group_by(Non_HDL_Kat, Durasi_DM) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Non_HDL_Kat) %>%
  mutate(Persentase = Jumlah / sum(Jumlah))

p_val_prop <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table(df_clean$Riwayat_DM, ifelse(df_clean$Non_HDL >= 130, 1, 0)))$p.value)
p_text_prop <- paste0("Signifikan, p = ", format(round(p_val_prop, 3), decimal.mark=","))

# ==========================================
# 2. PERSIAPAN DATA UNTUK GRAFIK KANAN (Vertikal)
# ==========================================
df_tbl4_vert <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Non_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(Non_HDL >= 130, "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)", "< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)"), 
                         levels = c("< 130 mg/dL\n(Optimal)", "\u2265 130 mg/dL\n(Tinggi)")),
    Durasi_DM = factor(Riwayat_DM, levels = c("Baru Terdiagnosis", "Sudah Lama"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Non_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Durasi_DM) & !is.na(Global_CAC_score))

df_pval_vert <- df_tbl4_vert %>%
  group_by(Non_HDL_Kat) %>%
  summarise(p_val = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(Global_CAC_score ~ Durasi_DM)$p.value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    p_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0,001", paste0("p = ", format(round(p_val, 3), decimal.mark=","))),
    font_style = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "bold", "plain"),
    color_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "#C0392B", "#7F8C8D") 
  )

df_med_vert <- df_tbl4_vert %>% 
  group_by(Non_HDL_Kat, Durasi_DM) %>%
  summarise(Median = median(Global_CAC_score, na.rm=T), Q1 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.25, na.rm=T), Q3 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.75, na.rm=T), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(
    m = format(round(Median,0), big.mark=".", trim=T), q1 = format(round(Q1,0), big.mark=".", trim=T), q3 = format(round(Q3,0), big.mark=".", trim=T),
    label_med = paste0(m, "(", q1, "-", q3, ")") 
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. MEMBANGUN GRAFIK KIRI (Panel A)
# ==========================================
p_kiri <- ggplot(df_tbl4_prop, aes(x = Non_HDL_Kat, y = Persentase, fill = Durasi_DM)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black", width = 0.55, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Jumlah, " Pasien\n(", percent(Persentase, accuracy = 1), ")")), 
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 5.5) +
  annotate("label", x = 1.5, y = 1.05, label = p_text_prop, size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "#8E44AD", fill = "#F4ECF7", label.size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Baru Terdiagnosis" = "#99A3A4", "Sudah Lama" = "#6C3483")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "A. Proporsi Durasi Diagnosis DM", x = "", y = "Proporsi Pasien (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # Legenda dimatikan (akan dikumpulkan di bawah)
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 20, margin = margin(b = 15))
  )

# ==========================================
# 4. MEMBANGUN GRAFIK KANAN (Panel B)
# ==========================================
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)
p_kanan <- ggplot(df_tbl4_vert, aes(x = Non_HDL_Kat, y = Global_CAC_score, fill = Durasi_DM)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Durasi_DM), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75), alpha = 0.5, size = 2.5, shape = 16) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, position = pd, width = 0.5) +
  
  geom_text(data = df_pval_vert, aes(x = Non_HDL_Kat, y = 6000, label = p_text, fontface = font_style, color = color_text), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Baru Terdiagnosis" = "#7F8C8D", "Sudah Lama" = "#512E5F")) + 
  
  geom_text(data = df_med_vert, aes(y = 4000, label = label_med, group = Durasi_DM), position = pd, vjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = "black", lineheight = 0.9) +
             
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Baru Terdiagnosis" = "#99A3A4", "Sudah Lama" = "#6C3483")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.4))) +
  
  labs(title = "B. Sebaran Skor Kalsifikasi", x = "", y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # Legenda dimatikan (akan dikumpulkan di bawah)
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 20, margin = margin(b = 15))
  )

# ==========================================
# 5. MENGGABUNGKAN KEDUANYA (Patchwork)
# ==========================================
# Menggunakan plot_layout(guides = "collect") untuk menyatukan legenda
p_final <- p_kiri + p_kanan + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Mengungkap Statin Paradox: Efek Durasi DM terhadap Kalsifikasi Koroner",
    subtitle = "Kelompok lipid optimal didominasi oleh pasien DM kronis (Panel A), yang berdampak pada tingginya kalsifikasi absolut (Panel B)",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 18, color = "#5D6D7E", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20))
    )
  ) & 
  # Tema global untuk mengatur legenda bersama yang dikumpulkan di bawah
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )

p_final

ggsave("Grafik/Grafik_Kombinasi_Paradoks_16x9_PPT.png", plot = p_final, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

# 1. Menyiapkan 8 Variabel Tidak Signifikan
df_cat_raw <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Non_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(Non_HDL >= 130, "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)", "< 130 (Optimal)"), 
                         levels = c("< 130 (Optimal)", "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)")),
    `Kategori Usia` = factor(ifelse(Usia >= 60, "\u2265 60 Thn", "< 60 Thn"), levels = c("< 60 Thn", "\u2265 60 Thn")),
    `Jenis Kelamin` = factor(Gender, levels = c("L", "P"), labels = c("Laki-laki", "Perempuan")),
    `Kategori IMT` = factor(ifelse(IMT >= 25, "Obesitas", "Normal/OW"), levels = c("Normal/OW", "Obesitas")),
    `Status Hipertensi` = factor(case_when(
       grepl("Tidak ada", Hipertensi_Kat) ~ "Tidak HT",
       grepl("Tidak Terkontrol", Hipertensi_Kat) ~ "HT Tdk Terkontrol",
       TRUE ~ "HT Terkontrol"
    ), levels = c("Tidak HT", "HT Terkontrol", "HT Tdk Terkontrol")),
    `Riwayat Merokok` = factor(Merokok, levels = c("Tidak Merokok", "Merokok")),
    `Kontrol Glikemik` = factor(ifelse(HbA1C >= 7.0, "\u2265 7.0%", "< 7.0%"), levels = c("< 7.0%", "\u2265 7.0%")),
    `Terapi DM` = factor(Terapi_DM, levels = c("Tanpa Terapi/Diet", "OAD", "Insulin"), labels = c("Diet", "OAD", "Insulin")),
    `Penggunaan Statin` = factor(Statin, levels = c("No-Statin", "On-Statin"), labels = c("Tanpa Statin", "Statin"))
  ) %>%
  select(Non_HDL_Kat, `Kategori Usia`, `Jenis Kelamin`, `Kategori IMT`, `Status Hipertensi`,
         `Riwayat Merokok`, `Kontrol Glikemik`, `Terapi DM`, `Penggunaan Statin`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Non_HDL_Kat, names_to = "Kategori", values_to = "Grup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Non_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Grup)) %>%
  mutate(Kategori = factor(Kategori, levels = c(
    "Kategori Usia", "Jenis Kelamin", "Kategori IMT", "Status Hipertensi",
    "Riwayat Merokok", "Kontrol Glikemik", "Terapi DM", "Penggunaan Statin"
  )))

# 2. Nilai P-value Absolut sesuai Tabel 4
df_pvals <- df_cat_raw %>%
  group_by(Kategori) %>%
  summarise(
    x_pos = (n_distinct(Grup) + 1) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_text = case_when(
      Kategori == "Kategori Usia" ~ "p = 0,062",
      Kategori == "Jenis Kelamin" ~ "p = 0,90",
      Kategori == "Kategori IMT" ~ "p = 0,30",
      Kategori == "Status Hipertensi" ~ "p = 0,50",
      Kategori == "Riwayat Merokok" ~ "p = 0,90",
      Kategori == "Kontrol Glikemik" ~ "p = 0,20",
      Kategori == "Terapi DM" ~ "p = 0,50",
      Kategori == "Penggunaan Statin" ~ "p = 0,20",
      TRUE ~ "p = -"
    ),
    font_style = "italic" 
  )

# 3. Proporsi Kolom yang Benar (Dibagi N total masing-masing kelompok Non-HDL: Optimal=28, Tinggi=24)
df_vis <- df_cat_raw %>%
  group_by(Kategori, Non_HDL_Kat, Grup) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Total_N = ifelse(Non_HDL_Kat == "< 130 (Optimal)", 28, 24),
    Persentase = Jumlah / Total_N,
    Persentase_Plot = ifelse(Non_HDL_Kat == "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)", -Persentase, Persentase),
    # KUNCI ESTETIKA: Sembunyikan teks jika kotaknya terlalu kecil (< 8%) agar tidak menumpuk
    Label_Teks = ifelse(Persentase > 0.08, paste0(Jumlah, " (", round(Persentase * 100), "%)"), "")
  )

# 4. Membangun Diverging Bar Chart yang Bersih & Rapi
p_diverging_tbl4 <- ggplot(df_vis, aes(x = Grup, y = Persentase_Plot, fill = Non_HDL_Kat)) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.65, linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Menampilkan label teks dengan ukuran yang proporsional dan aman dari tabrakan
  geom_text(aes(y = Persentase_Plot / 2, label = Label_Teks), 
            color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4.2) +
            
  geom_text(data = df_pvals, aes(x = x_pos, y = 1.25, label = p_text, fontface = font_style), 
            size = 6, color = "#7F8C8D", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
            
  facet_wrap(~ Kategori, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("< 130 (Optimal)" = "#16A085", "\u2265 130 (Tinggi)" = "#D35400")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(10)) +
  
  # Batas sumbu Y disesuaikan agar lapang
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) percent(abs(x), accuracy = 1), 
                     limits = c(-1.05, 1.4), breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Proporsi Karakteristik Klinis Berdasarkan Kategori Kolesterol Non-HDL",
    subtitle = "Distribusi karakteristik dasar seimbang pada kedua kelompok profil lipid (seluruh parameter p > 0,05)",
    x = "",
    y = "\u2265 130 (Tinggi) \u2193   Proporsi Pasien (%)   \u2191 < 130 (Optimal)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 5), lineheight = 0.8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 26, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 18, color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 25))
  )

p_diverging_tbl4

ggsave("Grafik/Table4_Karakteristik_NonSig_Diverging_PPT.png", plot = p_diverging_tbl4, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# ==========================================
# 1. PERSIAPAN DATA KIRI (Proporsi Kontrol Glikemik vs Rasio TG/HDL-C)
# ==========================================
df_tbl5_prop <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    TG_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(TG_HDL_Ratio >= 3.0, "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi)", "< 3,0 (Normal)"), 
                        levels = c("< 3,0 (Normal)", "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi)")),
    Kontrol_Glikemik = factor(ifelse(HbA1C >= 7.0, "\u2265 7,0% (Tidak Terkontrol)", "< 7,0% (Terkontrol)"),
                              levels = c("< 7,0% (Terkontrol)", "\u2265 7,0% (Tidak Terkontrol)"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TG_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Kontrol_Glikemik)) %>%
  group_by(TG_HDL_Kat, Kontrol_Glikemik) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(TG_HDL_Kat) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_N = sum(Jumlah),
    Persentase = Jumlah / Total_N
  )

p_text_prop5 <- "Signifikan, p = 0,044"

# ==========================================
# 2. PERSIAPAN DATA KANAN (Sebaran Vertikal Skor CAC Absolut)
# ==========================================
df_tbl5_vert <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    TG_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(TG_HDL_Ratio >= 3.0, "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi)", "< 3,0 (Normal)"), 
                        levels = c("< 3,0 (Normal)", "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi)")),
    Kontrol_Glikemik = factor(ifelse(HbA1C >= 7.0, "\u2265 7,0% (Tidak Terkontrol)", "< 7,0% (Terkontrol)"),
                              levels = c("< 7,0% (Terkontrol)", "\u2265 7,0% (Tidak Terkontrol)"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TG_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Kontrol_Glikemik) & !is.na(Global_CAC_score))

# Kalkulasi p-value komparasi skor CAC antar kontrol glikemik dalam kelompok TG/HDL-C
df_pval_vert5 <- df_tbl5_vert %>%
  group_by(TG_HDL_Kat) %>%
  summarise(p_val = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(Global_CAC_score ~ Kontrol_Glikemik)$p.value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    p_text = paste0("p = ", format(round(p_val, 3), decimal.mark=",")),
    font_style = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "bold", "plain"),
    color_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "#C0392B", "#7F8C8D")
  )

# Kalkulasi Median dan Q1-Q3 untuk Skor CAC
df_med_vert5 <- df_tbl5_vert %>% 
  group_by(TG_HDL_Kat, Kontrol_Glikemik) %>%
  summarise(
    Median = median(Global_CAC_score, na.rm=T), 
    Q1 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.25, na.rm=T), 
    Q3 = quantile(Global_CAC_score, 0.75, na.rm=T), 
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    m = format(round(Median,0), big.mark=".", trim=T),
    q1 = format(round(Q1,0), big.mark=".", trim=T),
    q3 = format(round(Q3,0), big.mark=".", trim=T),
    label_med = paste0(m, "\n(", q1, "-", q3, ")") 
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. MEMBANGUN PANEL KIRI (Proporsi)
# ==========================================
p_kiri5 <- ggplot(df_tbl5_prop, aes(x = TG_HDL_Kat, y = Persentase, fill = Kontrol_Glikemik)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black", width = 0.55, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Jumlah, " Pasien\n(", percent(Persentase, accuracy = 1), ")")), 
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  annotate("label", x = 1.5, y = 1.05, label = p_text_prop5, size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "#6C3483", fill = "#F4ECF7", label.size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("< 7,0% (Terkontrol)" = "#5B2C6F", "\u2265 7,0% (Tidak Terkontrol)" = "#F39C12")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "A. Proporsi Kontrol Glikemik Berdasarkan TG/HDL-C", x = "Kategori Rasio TG/HDL-C", y = "Proporsi Pasien (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18, margin = margin(b = 15))
  )

# ==========================================
# 4. MEMBANGUN PANEL KANAN (Sebaran Skor CAC Absolut)
# ==========================================
pd5 <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)
p_kanan5 <- ggplot(df_tbl5_vert, aes(x = TG_HDL_Kat, y = Global_CAC_score, fill = Kontrol_Glikemik)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Kontrol_Glikemik), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75), alpha = 0.5, size = 2.5, shape = 16) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, position = pd5, width = 0.5) +
  
  # P-value di atas
  geom_text(data = df_pval_vert5, aes(x = TG_HDL_Kat, y = 6000, label = p_text, fontface = font_style, color = color_text), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("< 7,0% (Terkontrol)" = "#4A235A", "\u2265 7,0% (Tidak Terkontrol)" = "#D68910")) + 
  
  # Median di bagian bawah (di atas lantai 0)
  geom_text(data = df_med_vert5, aes(y = 0, label = label_med, group = Kontrol_Glikemik), position = pd5, vjust = -0.3, size = 3.8, fontface = "bold", color = "black", lineheight = 0.9) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("< 7,0% (Terkontrol)" = "#5B2C6F", "\u2265 7,0% (Tidak Terkontrol)" = "#F39C12")) +
  
  # Skala Log1p agar sebaran CAC absolut terbaca sempurna dari 0 hingga >2000
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.35))) +
  
  labs(title = "B. Sebaran Beban Kalsifikasi (Skor CAC Absolut)", x = "Kategori Rasio TG/HDL-C", y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18, margin = margin(b = 15))
  )

# ==========================================
# 5. MENGGABUNGKAN KEDUANYA (Patchwork 16:9)
# ==========================================
p_final5 <- p_kiri5 + p_kanan5 + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Analisis Stratifikasi Rasio TG/HDL-C dan Beban Kalsifikasi Koroner (Tabel 5)",
    subtitle = "Kelompok rasio TG/HDL-C tinggi didominasi oleh pasien HbA1c \u2265 7,0% (p = 0,044), yang berkorelasi dengan eskalasi skor CAC",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 16, color = "#5D6D7E", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20))
    )
  ) & 
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm")
  )

p_final5
ggsave("Grafik/Table5_Kombinasi_16x9_PPT.png", plot = p_final5, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

# 1. Menyiapkan 7 Variabel Sesuai Tabel 5
df_cat_raw5 <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    TG_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(TG_HDL_Ratio >= 3.0, "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi)", "< 3,0 (Normal)"), 
                        levels = c("< 3,0 (Normal)", "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi)")),
    `Kategori Usia` = factor(ifelse(Usia >= 60, "\u2265 60 Thn", "< 60 Thn"), levels = c("< 60 Thn", "\u2265 60 Thn")),
    `Jenis Kelamin` = factor(Gender, levels = c("L", "P"), labels = c("Laki-laki", "Perempuan")),
    `Kategori IMT` = factor(ifelse(IMT >= 25, "Obesitas", "Normal/OW"), levels = c("Normal/OW", "Obesitas")),
    `Status Hipertensi` = factor(case_when(
       grepl("Tidak ada", Hipertensi_Kat) ~ "Tidak HT",
       grepl("Tidak Terkontrol", Hipertensi_Kat) ~ "HT Tdk Terkontrol",
       TRUE ~ "HT Terkontrol"
    ), levels = c("Tidak HT", "HT Terkontrol", "HT Tdk Terkontrol")),
    `Riwayat Merokok` = factor(Merokok, levels = c("Tidak Merokok", "Merokok")),
    `Durasi Diagnosis DM` = factor(Riwayat_DM, levels = c("Baru Terdiagnosis", "Sudah Lama")),
    `Modalitas Terapi DM` = factor(Terapi_DM, levels = c("Tanpa Terapi/Diet", "OAD", "Insulin"), labels = c("Diet", "OAD", "Insulin")),
    `Penggunaan Statin` = factor(Statin, levels = c("No-Statin", "On-Statin"), labels = c("Tanpa Statin", "Statin"))
  ) %>%
  select(TG_HDL_Kat, `Kategori Usia`, `Jenis Kelamin`, `Kategori IMT`, `Status Hipertensi`,
         `Riwayat Merokok`, `Durasi Diagnosis DM`, `Modalitas Terapi DM`, `Penggunaan Statin`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -TG_HDL_Kat, names_to = "Kategori", values_to = "Grup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(TG_HDL_Kat) & !is.na(Grup)) %>%
  mutate(Kategori = factor(Kategori, levels = c(
    "Kategori Usia", "Jenis Kelamin", "Kategori IMT", "Status Hipertensi",
    "Riwayat Merokok", "Durasi Diagnosis DM", "Modalitas Terapi DM", "Penggunaan Statin"
  )))

# 2. Nilai P-value Absolut sesuai Tabel 5
df_pvals5 <- df_cat_raw5 %>%
  group_by(Kategori) %>%
  summarise(
    x_pos = (n_distinct(Grup) + 1) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_text = case_when(
      Kategori == "Kategori Usia" ~ "p = 0,077",
      Kategori == "Jenis Kelamin" ~ "p = 0,40",
      Kategori == "Kategori IMT" ~ "p = 0,60",
      Kategori == "Status Hipertensi" ~ "p = 0,30",
      Kategori == "Riwayat Merokok" ~ "p = 0,20",
      Kategori == "Durasi Diagnosis DM" ~ "p = 0,60",
      Kategori == "Modalitas Terapi DM" ~ "p = 0,60",
      Kategori == "Penggunaan Statin" ~ "p = 0,70",
      TRUE ~ "p = -"
    ),
    font_style = "italic" 
  )

# 3. Proporsi Kolom (Dibagi N total kelompok TG/HDL: Normal=22, Tinggi=30)
df_vis5 <- df_cat_raw5 %>%
  group_by(Kategori, TG_HDL_Kat, Grup) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Total_N = ifelse(TG_HDL_Kat == "< 3,0 (Normal)", 22, 30),
    Persentase = Jumlah / Total_N,
    Persentase_Plot = ifelse(TG_HDL_Kat == "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi)", -Persentase, Persentase),
    Label_Teks = ifelse(Persentase > 0.08, paste0(Jumlah, " (", round(Persentase * 100), "%)"), "")
  )

# 4. Membangun Diverging Bar Chart 8 Panel (2 Baris x 4 Kolom)
p_diverging_tbl5 <- ggplot(df_vis5, aes(x = Grup, y = Persentase_Plot, fill = TG_HDL_Kat)) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.65, linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  geom_text(aes(y = Persentase_Plot / 2, label = Label_Teks), 
            color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4.2) +
            
  geom_text(data = df_pvals5, aes(x = x_pos, y = 1.25, label = p_text, fontface = font_style), 
            size = 6, color = "#7F8C8D", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
            
  facet_wrap(~ Kategori, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4) +
  
  # Palet Warna Eksklusif Tabel 5: Deep Indigo & Golden Ochre
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("< 3,0 (Normal)" = "#4A235A", "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi)" = "#D4AC0D")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(10)) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) percent(abs(x), accuracy = 1), 
                     limits = c(-1.05, 1.4), breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Karakteristik Klinis Berdasarkan Kategori Rasio TG/HDL-C",
    subtitle = "Distribusi parameter penunjang seimbang pada kedua kelompok rasio TG/HDL-C (seluruh parameter p > 0,05)",
    x = "",
    y = "\u2265 3,0 (Tinggi) \u2193   Proporsi Pasien (%)   \u2191 < 3,0 (Normal)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 5), lineheight = 0.8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 26, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 18, color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 25))
  )

p_diverging_tbl5
ggsave("Grafik/Table5_Karakteristik_NonSig_Diverging_PPT.png", plot = p_diverging_tbl5, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-stratifikasi-sua-hdl

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. PERSIAPAN DATA UNTUK BAR PLOT (Sesuai persis dengan angka Tabel 9)
# ==============================================================================
# Data Kategori Usia (p = 0.044)
df_bar_usia <- data.frame(
  SUA_HDL = factor(rep(c("\u2264 Median\n(Rendah)", "> Median\n(Tinggi)"), each = 2), 
                   levels = c("\u2264 Median\n(Rendah)", "> Median\n(Tinggi)")),
  Kategori = factor(rep(c("\u2265 60 Tahun", "< 60 Tahun"), 2), 
                    levels = c("\u2265 60 Tahun", "< 60 Tahun")),
  Count = c(20, 6, 13, 13),
  Prop = c(77, 23, 50, 50)
)

# Data Kategori IMT (p = 0.039)
df_bar_imt <- data.frame(
  SUA_HDL = factor(rep(c("\u2264 Median\n(Rendah)", "> Median\n(Tinggi)"), each = 2), 
                   levels = c("\u2264 Median\n(Rendah)", "> Median\n(Tinggi)")),
  Kategori = factor(rep(c("Normal/Overweight", "Obesitas"), 2), 
                    levels = c("Normal/Overweight", "Obesitas")),
  Count = c(12, 14, 5, 21),
  Prop = c(46, 54, 19, 81)
)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. PERSIAPAN DATA UNTUK BOXPLOT DARI DATASET ASLI (df_clean)
# ==============================================================================
# Memastikan variabel kategori tersedia untuk plotting sebaran CAC
df_box <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Hitung Rasio SUA/HDL dan tentukan mediannya
    SUA_HDL_Ratio = `Asam-Urat` / HDL,
    SUA_HDL_Med = median(SUA_HDL_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    SUA_HDL_Kat = factor(ifelse(SUA_HDL_Ratio <= SUA_HDL_Med, 
                                "\u2264 Median\n(Rendah)", "> Median\n(Tinggi)"),
                         levels = c("\u2264 Median\n(Rendah)", "> Median\n(Tinggi)")),
    
    # Kategori Usia
    Usia_Kat = factor(ifelse(Usia < 60, "< 60 Tahun", "\u2265 60 Tahun"),
                      levels = c("\u2265 60 Tahun", "< 60 Tahun")),
    
    # Kategori IMT (Asumsi cutoff Obesitas Asia-Pasifik >= 25)
    IMT_Kat = factor(ifelse(IMT >= 25, "Obesitas", "Normal/Overweight"),
                     levels = c("Normal/Overweight", "Obesitas")),
    
    # Skor CAC untuk skala Log
    CAC_Plot = Global_CAC_score + 1
  ) %>% filter(!is.na(SUA_HDL_Kat))

# ==============================================================================
# 3. MEMBUAT GRAFIK INDIVIDUAL
# ==============================================================================

# Tema dasar agar konsisten
custom_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

# --- PANEL A: Bar Plot Usia ---
p_bar_usia <- ggplot(df_bar_usia, aes(x = SUA_HDL, y = Prop, fill = Kategori)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d Pasien\n(%d%%)", Count, Prop)), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("\u2265 60 Tahun" = "#2C3E50", "< 60 Tahun" = "#3498DB")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  annotate("label", x = 1.5, y = 105, label = "Signifikan, p = 0,044", 
           color = "#2C3E50", fontface = "bold", fill = "#EAECEE", size = 4.5) +
  labs(title = "A. Proporsi Kategori Usia Berdasarkan SUA/HDL-C", x = "Kategori Rasio SUA/HDL-C", y = "Proporsi Pasien (%)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 115)) +
  custom_theme

# --- PANEL B: Boxplot CAC Berdasarkan Usia ---
p_box_usia <- ggplot(df_box, aes(x = SUA_HDL_Kat, y = CAC_Plot, fill = Usia_Kat)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("\u2265 60 Tahun" = "#2C3E50", "< 60 Tahun" = "#3498DB")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = c(1, 11, 101, 501, 1001, 2001), 
                     labels = c("0", "10", "100", "500", "1000", "2000")) +
  labs(title = "B. Sebaran Skor Kalsifikasi (Sub-grup Usia)", x = "Kategori Rasio SUA/HDL-C", y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston)") +
  custom_theme

# --- PANEL C: Bar Plot IMT ---
p_bar_imt <- ggplot(df_bar_imt, aes(x = SUA_HDL, y = Prop, fill = Kategori)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d Pasien\n(%d%%)", Count, Prop)), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normal/Overweight" = "#D68910", "Obesitas" = "#C0392B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  annotate("label", x = 1.5, y = 105, label = "Signifikan, p = 0,039", 
           color = "#C0392B", fontface = "bold", fill = "#FADBD8", size = 4.5) +
  labs(title = "C. Proporsi Kategori IMT Berdasarkan SUA/HDL-C", x = "Kategori Rasio SUA/HDL-C", y = "Proporsi Pasien (%)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 115)) +
  custom_theme

# --- PANEL D: Boxplot CAC Berdasarkan IMT ---
p_box_imt <- ggplot(df_box, aes(x = SUA_HDL_Kat, y = CAC_Plot, fill = IMT_Kat)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normal/Overweight" = "#D68910", "Obesitas" = "#C0392B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = c(1, 11, 101, 501, 1001, 2001), 
                     labels = c("0", "10", "100", "500", "1000", "2000")) +
  labs(title = "D. Sebaran Skor Kalsifikasi (Sub-grup IMT)", x = "Kategori Rasio SUA/HDL-C", y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston)") +
  custom_theme

# ==============================================================================
# 4. PENGGABUNGAN GRID (PATCHWORK 16:9)
# ==============================================================================
layout_final <- (p_bar_usia | p_box_usia) / (p_bar_imt | p_box_imt) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Analisis Stratifikasi Rasio SUA/HDL-C, Profil Klinis, dan Skor Kalsifikasi Koroner (Tabel 9)",
    subtitle = "Peningkatan rasio SUA/HDL-C secara signifikan didominasi oleh pasien usia muda (< 60 Tahun) dan pasien obesitas.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5, t = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 15, color = "#5D6D7E", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF", color = NA)
    )
  )

# Tampilkan plot
layout_final

ggsave("Grafik/Gambar_Stratifikasi_SUA_HDL_16x9.png", plot = layout_final, width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-tbl6-forest

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Menyusun Data Hasil Tabel 6 ke dalam Dataframe R
df_forest <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Model 1: Kolesterol Non-HDL", "Model 1: Usia (Tahun)", 
            "Model 2: Rasio TG/HDL-C", "Model 2: Usia (Tahun)"),
  Variabel = c("Kolesterol Non-HDL", "Usia", "Rasio TG/HDL-C", "Usia"),
  Beta = c(-0.02, 0.08, -0.13, 0.08),
  Lower = c(-0.04, 0.01, -0.26, 0.02),
  Upper = c(0.00, 0.14, 0.00, 0.15),
  # Format teks Beta agar menggunakan koma desimal
  Beta_Label = c("\u03B2 = -0,02", "\u03B2 = 0,08", "\u03B2 = -0,13", "\u03B2 = 0,08"),
  P_Value = c("p = 0,017", "p = 0,026", "p = 0,047", "p = 0,013"),
  Kategori_Prediktor = c("Lipid (Non-HDL)", "Perancu (Usia)", "Lipid (TG/HDL-C)", "Perancu (Usia)")
) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = rev(c("Model 1: Kolesterol Non-HDL", "Model 1: Usia (Tahun)", 
                                             "Model 2: Rasio TG/HDL-C", "Model 2: Usia (Tahun)"))))

# 2. Membangun Forest Plot dengan Nilai Beta di Titik Plot
p_forest <- ggplot(df_forest, aes(x = Beta, y = Model, color = Kategori_Prediktor)) +
  
  # Garis referensi vertikal nol (Null line)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#7F8C8D", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Garis Rentang 95% CI
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # Titik Estimasi Koefisien Beta
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 18) + 
  
  # KUNCI PERBAIKAN: Menambahkan label nilai Beta tepat di atas titik plot (vjust negatif agar melayang di atas titik)
  geom_text(aes(label = Beta_Label), vjust = -1.5, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Menambahkan Teks Nilai P di sebelah kanan grafik
  geom_text(aes(x = 0.22, label = P_Value), fontface = "bold", size = 5.5, color = "black", hjust = 0) +
  
  # Palet Warna: Crimson Red (Lipid) vs Deep Navy (Usia)
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lipid (Non-HDL)" = "#C0392B", "Lipid (TG/HDL-C)" = "#C0392B", "Perancu (Usia)" = "#1B4F72")) +
  
  # Batas sumbu X sedikit diperlebar agar label di titik tidak terpotong atap
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.32, 0.30), breaks = c(-0.25, -0.13, 0.00, 0.08, 0.15)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Analisis Regresi Linear Multivariat terhadap Log Kalsifikasi",
    subtitle = "Koefisien Regresi (\u03B2) dan 95% Confidence Interval setelah Mengontrol Efek Usia",
    x = "Koefisien Regresi (\u03B2) dengan 95% CI",
    y = ""
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "black", hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 5)),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 24, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 16, color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 25)),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 30, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

p_forest
ggsave("Grafik/Table6_ForestPlot_PPT.png", plot = p_forest, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# 1. Menyiapkan Data Dasar & Kategori Usia
df_base <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Kelompok_Usia = factor(ifelse(Usia >= 60, "\u2265 60 Tahun (Lansia)", "< 60 Tahun"), 
                           levels = c("< 60 Tahun", "\u2265 60 Tahun (Lansia)"))
  )

# ==========================================
# 2. MEMBANGUN PANEL KIRI (Model 1: Non-HDL)
# ==========================================
df_sc_kiri <- df_base %>% filter(!is.na(Non_HDL) & !is.na(Global_CAC_score) & !is.na(Kelompok_Usia))

p_kiri_sc <- ggplot(df_sc_kiri, aes(x = Non_HDL, y = Global_CAC_score, color = Kelompok_Usia)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3, position = position_jitter(width = 1, height = 0.05)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("< 60 Tahun" = "#16A085", "\u2265 60 Tahun (Lansia)" = "#C0392B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Model 1: Kolesterol Non-HDL",
    subtitle = "(\u03B2 = -0,02, p = 0,017)",
    x = "Kolesterol Non-HDL (mg/dL)",
    y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston, Skala Log)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # Legenda disatukan di bawah secara global
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(t = 12)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 14, color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 15))
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. MEMBANGUN PANEL KANAN (Model 2: Rasio TG/HDL-C)
# ==========================================
df_sc_kanan <- df_base %>% filter(!is.na(TG_HDL_Ratio) & !is.na(Global_CAC_score) & !is.na(Kelompok_Usia))

p_kanan_sc <- ggplot(df_sc_kanan, aes(x = TG_HDL_Ratio, y = Global_CAC_score, color = Kelompok_Usia)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3, position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.05)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("< 60 Tahun" = "#16A085", "\u2265 60 Tahun (Lansia)" = "#C0392B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Model 2: Rasio TG/HDL-C",
    subtitle = "(\u03B2 = -0,13, p = 0,047)",
    x = "Rasio TG/HDL-C",
    y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston, Skala Log)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(t = 12)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 14, color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 15))
  )

# ==========================================
# 4. MENGGABUNGKAN KEDUANYA (Patchwork 16:9)
# ==========================================
p_final_scatter <- p_kiri_sc + p_kanan_sc + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Analisis Regresi Multivariat: Hubungan Profil Lipid terhadap Beban Kalsifikasi Koroner",
    subtitle = "Menunjukkan tren hubungan berlawanan arah yang signifikan setelah dikontrol terhadap efek perancu Usia",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 8)),
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# Memastikan model regresi multivariat tersimpan (Contoh penamaan objek model R Dokter)
# mod_nhdl <- lm(log1p(Global_CAC_score) ~ Non_HDL + Usia, data = df_clean)
# mod_tg   <- lm(log1p(Global_CAC_score) ~ TG_HDL_Ratio + Usia, data = df_clean)

df_base <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Kelompok_Usia = factor(ifelse(Usia >= 60, "\u2265 60 Tahun (Lansia)", "< 60 Tahun"), 
                           levels = c("< 60 Tahun", "\u2265 60 Tahun (Lansia)"))
  )

# ==========================================
# PANEL KIRI: Model 1 (Non-HDL + Usia)
# ==========================================
p_kiri_sc <- ggplot(df_base %>% filter(!is.na(Non_HDL) & !is.na(Global_CAC_score)), 
                    aes(x = Non_HDL, y = Global_CAC_score, color = Kelompok_Usia)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3, position = position_jitter(width = 1, height = 0.05)) +
  # Menggunakan metode regresi linear terkontrol
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("< 60 Tahun" = "#16A085", "\u2265 60 Tahun (Lansia)" = "#C0392B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Model 1: Kolesterol Non-HDL",
    subtitle = "(\u03B2 = -0,02, p = 0,017 [Disesuaikan terhadap Usia])",
    x = "Kolesterol Non-HDL (mg/dL)",
    y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston, Skala Log)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1.1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(t = 12)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 13, color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 15))
  )

# ==========================================
# PANEL KANAN: Model 2 (Rasio TG/HDL-C + Usia)
# ==========================================
p_kanan_sc <- ggplot(df_base %>% filter(!is.na(TG_HDL_Ratio) & !is.na(Global_CAC_score)), 
                     aes(x = TG_HDL_Ratio, y = Global_CAC_score, color = Kelompok_Usia)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3, position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.05)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("< 60 Tahun" = "#16A085", "\u2265 60 Tahun (Lansia)" = "#C0392B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2000), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Model 2: Rasio TG/HDL-C",
    subtitle = "(\u03B2 = -0,13, p = 0,047 [Disesuaikan terhadap Usia])",
    x = "Rasio TG/HDL-C",
    y = "Skor CAC Absolut (Agatston, Skala Log)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(

  )

# ==========================================
# PENGGABUNGAN AKHIR (16:9 Patchwork)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-supp-statin_ppt
#| fig-cap: "Analisis korelasi kolesterol non-HDL dan Rasio TG/HDL-C terhadap kalsifikasi berdasarkan penggunaan Statin. Titik sebaran diwarnai berdasarkan usia pasien (spektrum biru untuk usia lebih muda, hingga merah untuk usia lebih tua), sementara bentuk titik membedakan durasi diabetes mellitus."
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 8.5
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Menyiapkan data untuk facet (Durasi DM Kat)
df_strat <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Durasi_DM_Kat = case_when(
      Durasi_DM_Bulan == 0 ~ "Baru Terdiagnosis",
      Durasi_DM_Bulan > 0 & Durasi_DM_Bulan < 60 ~ "DM < 5 Tahun",
      Durasi_DM_Bulan >= 60 ~ "DM \u2265 5 Tahun",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Durasi_DM_Kat = factor(Durasi_DM_Kat, levels = c("Baru Terdiagnosis", "DM < 5 Tahun", "DM \u2265 5 Tahun"))
  ) %>%
  select(log_CAC, Statin, Non_HDL, TG_HDL_Ratio, Usia, Durasi_DM_Kat) %>%
  mutate(
    Statin = factor(Statin, levels = c("No-Statin", "On-Statin"), labels = c("Tanpa Statin (n=15)", "Pengguna Statin (n=37)")),
    `Kolesterol Non-HDL` = Non_HDL,
    `Rasio TG/HDL-C` = TG_HDL_Ratio
  ) %>%
  select(-Non_HDL, -TG_HDL_Ratio) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Kolesterol Non-HDL`, `Rasio TG/HDL-C`), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c("Kolesterol Non-HDL", "Rasio TG/HDL-C")))

# 2. Menghitung statistik untuk text label (Spearman)
df_strat_stats <- df_strat %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value) & !is.na(log_CAC)) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Statin) %>%
  summarise(
    rho = suppressWarnings(cor(Value, log_CAC, method = "spearman")),
    p_val = suppressWarnings(cor.test(Value, log_CAC, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_text = ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", p_val)),
    label_text = sprintf("rho = %.3f\np %s", rho, p_text),
    font_style = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "bold", "plain")
  )

# 3. Membuat Plot Stratifikasi dengan Title & Subtitle Lengkap
p_strat <- ggplot(df_strat, aes(x = Value, y = log_CAC)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(color = Usia, shape = Durasi_DM_Kat), size = 3.8, alpha = 0.9) + 
  
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("#2b83ba", "#abdda4", "#fdae61", "#d7191c"), 
    name = "Usia\n(Tahun)"
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(16, 17, 15), 
    name = "Durasi DM"
  ) +
  
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#c0392b", fill = "#f5b7b1", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  geom_label(data = df_strat_stats, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label_text, fontface = font_style),
             hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.15, size = 4, color = "black", 
             fill = alpha("#ffffff", 0.85), label.size = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
             
  facet_grid(Statin ~ Variable, scales = "free_x") +
  
  # PENAMBAHAN TITLE & SUBTITLE BERDASARKAN CAPTION
  labs(
    title = "Analisis Korelasi Parameter Lipid terhadap Kalsifikasi Berdasarkan Penggunaan Statin",
    subtitle = "Titik sebaran diwarnai berdasarkan spektrum usia pasien (biru: lebih muda, merah: lebih tua), dengan bentuk titik membedakan durasi diabetes melitus.",
    x = "Nilai Parameter Lipid", 
    y = "ln(Global CAC Score + 1)"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    # Pengaturan Judul & Subjudul agar simetris dan elegan di layar 16:9
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 14, color = "#5D6D7E", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#EAEDED", color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#E5E7E9", linewidth = 0.5),
    
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.9), color = "gray80"),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20)
  )

p_strat
ggsave("Grafik/Gambar1_Stratifikasi_Statin_16x9.png", plot = p_strat, width = 15, height = 8.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-supp-scatter-16x9-spacer
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# 1. Menyiapkan Data dan Variabel
df_prep <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    log_CAC = log(Global_CAC_score + 1),
    Usia = Usia,
    IMT = IMT,
    `Durasi DM` = if("Durasi_DM_Bulan" %in% names(.)) Durasi_DM_Bulan else if("Durasi_DM" %in% names(.)) Durasi_DM else 0,
    Hemoglobin = if("Hemoglobin" %in% names(.)) Hemoglobin else if("Hb" %in% names(.)) Hb else NA_real_,
    HbA1C = HbA1C,
    `Asam Urat` = if("Asam-Urat" %in% names(.)) `Asam-Urat` else Asam_Urat,
    Kreatinin = if("Kreatinin" %in% names(.)) Kreatinin else Kreatinin,
    Trigliserida = Trigliserida,
    `HDL-C` = HDL,
    `LDL-C` = LDL,
    `Kolesterol Total` = if("Kolesterol-Total" %in% names(.)) `Kolesterol-Total` else (`Kolesterol-Total`),
    `TyHbA1c Index` = log(Trigliserida * HbA1C),
    `TG / HDL-C Ratio` = Trigliserida / HDL,
    `Non-HDL Cholesterol` = `Kolesterol Total` - HDL,
    `SUA / HDL-C Ratio` = `Asam Urat` / HDL
  )

# 2. Fungsi Pembuat Scatter Plot Individual yang Kompak untuk 4 Kolom
create_scatter_plot <- function(data, x_var, x_label) {
  df_sub <- data %>% select(log_CAC, x_val = !!sym(x_var)) %>% filter(!is.na(x_val) & !is.na(log_CAC))
  
  rho <- suppressWarnings(cor(df_sub$x_val, df_sub$log_CAC, method = "spearman"))
  p_val <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df_sub$x_val, df_sub$log_CAC, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value)
  
  p_text <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", p_val))
  label_text <- sprintf("rho = %.3f\np %s", rho, p_text)
  font_style <- ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "bold", "plain")
  
  stat_df <- data.frame(label_text = label_text, font_style = font_style)
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = !!sym(x_var), y = log_CAC)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6, color = "#2c3e50") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#d35400", fill = "#edbb99", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_label(data = stat_df, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label_text, fontface = font_style),
               hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.15, size = 2.5, color = "black", 
               fill = alpha("#ffffff", 0.85), label.size = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    labs(title = x_label, x = NULL, y = "ln(CAC + 1)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#E5E7E9", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 3, r = 3, b = 3, l = 3)
    )
}

# 3. Membuat List Plot dengan Menyisipkan plot_spacer() di Posisi ke-4
plots <- list(
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "Usia", "Usia"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "IMT", "IMT"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "Durasi DM", "Durasi DM"),
  plot_spacer(), # <--- Mengosongkan slot ke-4 di baris pertama
  
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "Hemoglobin", "Hemoglobin"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "HbA1C", "HbA1c"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "Asam Urat", "Asam Urat"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "Kreatinin", "Kreatinin"),
  
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "Trigliserida", "Trigliserida"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "HDL-C", "HDL-C"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "LDL-C", "LDL-C"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "Kolesterol Total", "Kolesterol Total"),
  
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "TyHbA1c Index", "TyHbA1c Index"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "TG / HDL-C Ratio", "TG / HDL-C Ratio"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "Non-HDL Cholesterol", "Non-HDL Cholesterol"),
  create_scatter_plot(df_prep, "SUA / HDL-C Ratio", "SUA / HDL-C Ratio")
)

# 4. Membungkus dengan ncol = 4 secara bersih
grid_layout <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Korelasi Parameter Klinis, Laboratorium, dan Indeks Kardiometabolik",
    subtitle = "Analisis sebaran bivariat terhadap ln(Global CAC Score + 1) menggunakan koefisien korelasi Spearman (rho)",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12, color = "#5D6D7E", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)
    )
  )

grid_layout

ggsave("Grafik/Gambar3_Korelasi_CustomGrid_16x9.png", plot = grid_layout, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  # 8. JUDUL & SUBJUDUL PRESENTASI (TEMA 16:9)
  # ==========================================
  labs(
    title = "Diskrepansi Temuan HRP: Dampak Masifnya Penggunaan Statin",
    subtitle = "Perbedaan profil kohort (Naif Statin vs. Real-World) menyebabkan gagalnya indeks novel dalam memprediksi status HRP."
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26, color = "#2F3E46", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 15, b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 16, color = "#6A7F62", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )
```
