```{r}
#| label: fig-ilustrasi-bias-farmakologis-final
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. MEMBUAT DATA DUMMY KONSEPTUAL (Simulasi 10 Tahun)
# ==============================================================================
set.seed(123)
waktu <- seq(-10, 0, by = 0.05) # Garis waktu dari 10 tahun lalu hingga saat ini (0)

# A. Simulasi Fluktuasi Lipid & Efek Statin
lipid <- 75 + 15 * sin(waktu * 1.5) + 10 * cos(waktu * 3.2) + 5 * rnorm(length(waktu))
efek_statin <- ifelse(waktu > -1.5, (waktu + 1.5) * 40, 0)
lipid <- lipid - efek_statin

# B. Simulasi Fluktuasi Gula Darah & Efek OAD/Insulin
gula <- 65 + 12 * cos(waktu * 1.1) + 12 * sin(waktu * 2.7) + 5 * rnorm(length(waktu))
efek_dm <- ifelse(waktu > -1.5, (waktu + 1.5) * 30, 0)
gula <- gula - efek_dm

# C. Simulasi Progresi Kalsifikasi (CAC)
cac <- 5 + 85 * ((waktu + 10) / 10)^3 

df_konsep <- data.frame(waktu, lipid, gula, cac)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. MEMBANGUN GRAFIK KONSEPTUAL (STORYTELLING VISUAL)
# ==============================================================================
p_konsep <- ggplot(df_konsep, aes(x = waktu)) +
  
  # --- LATAR BELAKANG: AREA KALSIFIKASI ---
  geom_area(aes(y = cac), fill = "#D4D6C8", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cac, color = "Beban Kalsifikasi Koroner (CAC)"), linewidth = 2) +
  
  # --- GARIS DEPAN: FLUKTUASI METABOLIK ---
  geom_line(aes(y = lipid, color = "Profil Lipid (Kolesterol/TG)"), linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_line(aes(y = gula, color = "Profil Glikemik (Gula Darah)"), linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  
  # --- PENANDA TITIK INTERVENSI & EVALUASI ---
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#C0392B", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # Tanda Silang (X) Raksasa di Titik CTCA (Waktu = 0)
  annotate("point", x = 0, y = df_konsep$lipid[length(waktu)], shape = 4, size = 8, stroke = 3, color = "#5E8C94") +
  annotate("point", x = 0, y = df_konsep$gula[length(waktu)], shape = 4, size = 8, stroke = 3, color = "#D68910") +
  annotate("point", x = 0, y = df_konsep$cac[length(waktu)], shape = 4, size = 8, stroke = 3, color = "#C06E52") +

  # ==============================================================================
  # --- ANOTASI TEKS (DITARIK KE ATAS AGAR TIDAK NABRAK GARIS) ---
  # ==============================================================================
  # Zona Kiri (Y dinaikkan dari 105 ke 132)
  annotate("text", x = -6, y = 132, label = "FASE PAPARAN TOKSIK ALAMIAH (BERTAHUN-TAHUN)", 
           fontface = "bold", size = 5.5, color = "#2F3E46") +
  annotate("text", x = -6, y = 124, label = "Fluktuasi lipid & glikemik yang liar perlahan merusak endotel,\nmemicu akumulasi kalsifikasi plak yang ireversibel.", 
           fontface = "italic", size = 5, color = "#4F5D66", lineheight = 1.2) +
  
  # Zona Kanan Bias (Y dinaikkan ke 132)
  annotate("text", x = -0.75, y = 132, label = "BIAS\nFARMAKOLOGIS", 
           fontface = "bold", size = 5, color = "#C0392B", lineheight = 1.1) +
  
  # Label Tanda Silang CAC (Y dinaikkan ke 110)
  annotate("label", x = -0.2, y = 110, label = "Skor CAC Aktual:\nTinggi & Menetap", 
           fontface = "bold", size = 4.5, color = "#C06E52", fill = "white", hjust = 1) +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.2, y = 110, xend = 0, yend = df_konsep$cac[length(waktu)] + 2, 
           arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "#C06E52", linewidth = 1) +
           
  # Label Tanda Silang Lab (Sedikit digeser agar panahnya rapi)
  annotate("label", x = -0.2, y = 20, label = "Nilai Lab Saat Ini:\nTampak 'Normal/Rendah'\nakibat intervensi Statin & OAD", 
           fontface = "bold", size = 4.5, color = "#2F3E46", fill = "white", hjust = 1) +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.2, y = 20, xend = 0, yend = df_konsep$lipid[length(waktu)] + 5, 
           arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "#2F3E46", linewidth = 1) +

  # --- SKALA & TEMA ---
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Beban Kalsifikasi Koroner (CAC)" = "#C06E52", 
    "Profil Lipid (Kolesterol/TG)" = "#5E8C94", 
    "Profil Glikemik (Gula Darah)" = "#D68910"
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-10, -8, -6, -4, -2, -1.5, 0), 
                     labels = c("-10 Thn", "-8 Thn", "-6 Thn", "-4 Thn", "-2 Thn", "Mulai Obat", "CTCA (Saat Ini)")) +
  
  # BAPAK/IBU, BATAS MAKSIMAL DITINGGIKAN DI SINI (Y limits 0 - 140)
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = NULL, limits = c(0, 140)) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "Ilustrasi Konseptual: Mengapa Indeks Darah 'Saat Ini' Gagal Memprediksi CAC",
    subtitle = "Ketidaksesuaian (Discordance) antara nilai laboratorium yang tersamarkan oleh obat dengan beban kalsifikasi kronis yang telah terbentuk.",
    x = "Garis Waktu (Timeline)",
    y = "Intensitas & Keparahan Relatif",
    color = "Parameter Evaluasi:"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, hjust = 0.5, color = "#2F3E46", margin = margin(b = 8, t = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 15, hjust = 0.5, color = "#6A7F62", margin = margin(b = 20)),
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 15)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, color = "#2F3E46"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.2),
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 25, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

p_konsep
ggsave("Grafik/Ilustrasi_Bias_Farmakologis_16x9.png", plot = p_konsep, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
